notes_for_editor: Thin record. Build year 1951 rests on one 1977 newspaper item quoted by Forest Lookouts; the Register gives none. Current condition rests on the Register's present-tense description (missing lower stairs); no 2025-26 source found and access is undocumented. Do not conflate with Fire Tower Camp on Smith Lake, Crane Hill: a different, 109-foot restored tower seen only in search snippets. Thomas Kaufmann's 1819 News column and the Alabama forestry history PDF were read and do not mention Grandview. Coordinates in the record (34.1336, -86.9246) match the Register's 34 08 01 N, 86 55 29 W.
